name: Suerrat

traits.name: Cold Resistance
traits.description: A thick coat of hair makes Suerrat resistant to cold — damage from cold is reduced by 1D — but less tolerant of heat: damage from heat is increased by 1D.

traits.name: Poor Senses
traits.description: Suerrat eyes are sensitive to bright light but superior in the dark. They suffer DM-1 to vision checks in light equal to or greater than normal daylight (unless wearing protective lenses such as sunglasses), and gain DM+1 to vision checks in the dark provided there is some light source, however dim.

traits.name: Radiation Resistance
traits.description: An abundance of cell and DNA repair proteins lets Suerrat ignore the first 50 rads received in any radiation exposure event.

traits.name: Accelerated Ageing
traits.description: Suerrat begin ageing rolls at 34 (end of the fourth term) like humans, but ageing rolls gain DM+1 in addition to any other modifiers.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4, Mongoose Publishing
